content: STAGE 1 - scope and evidence audit. Goal: check each of the 7 proposals against the scope contract and find the evidence anchors in the frozen bundles. Read: all seven bundles (68dcd879bd52066f, 28b5638c2c1b4115, 7e2173f07d3603e3, 3e67caf8ffdb8045, 8381a1faae8643c0, caf10ee0bc541fb6, 6320f35ec38ee04e). Observed: the OBSERVED block E4-E11 is identical across all seven bundles; only E1-E3 and E12-E14 (PROPOSED) differ, so ranking must lean on the shared measurements. Key anchors: E6 width-20 beam survival - l1_br (fully hyperbolic deep assignment) has depth-1/2/3 survival 1.000 and recall@10 0.04671; l1_br_euclid 0.06207 with depth-3 survival 0.161; resample 0.06363 with depth-4 survival 0.088. E7 teacher-forced NLL - l1_br T1/T2/T3/T4 = 0.00/0.00/0.00/9.03 (degenerate prefix) versus l1_br_euclid 0.00/3.22/4.36/1.23 and resample 4.55/3.82/0.73/0.05. E5 successor-entropy stratification top-1 mass 0.4375 in bin 1 vs 0.0543 in bin 5. E9 cohort-profile signal 0.9291 vs 0.8871 negative and 0.5898 ordering. E10 mean outgoing degree 5.4526, edge density 5.3266 (per-item transition statistics are sparse). E8 K=256 co-location 0.0822 versus K=64 0.1547 (larger coarse K hurts behavioural co-location). Reasoning: E6/E7 punish mechanisms that let a strongly curved deep assignment degenerate, and warn that a 4th SID position is weakly predictable (survival 0.068-0.088 across all probes). E8 punishes raising K at levels 1-2. E10 punishes per-item sparse successor statistics used without aggregation. Still open: exact ordering of the middle five.

FINAL: all seven ranked once, positions 1-7 no ties. Order HYSPLIT-BEHV-RQ, BCMID-L3-RQ, BEHDIR-L4, BISECT-L4-ASYM, HOLO-TILT-L3, CGREP-4L-RQ, GYRO-BEHAFF-SID. Grounds: shared E5-E11 plus each E12-E14. E6/E7: 4th position weakly recoverable (0.068-0.088) and fully curved deep map degenerates (l1_br T3 NLL 0.00, recall 0.04671 vs l1_br_euclid 0.06207); E8 K=256 co-locates better than larger coarse K; E10 sparse transitions (degree 5.45) favour aggregated behaviour estimates, so monotone deep refinement preserving 3 tokens ranks first and whole-partition rewrites last.
